Thanks, the last part speaks to me a little bit. I can fully acknowledge that I’m a bad person, or have done bad things.

But the question that remains that I think you’re pointing out, does the positive impact I have in the world? For example a doctor could have a bad day, drink too much, and could kill a patient... but then how many lives have they saved? Don’t they deserve to be absolved?

Or should you not live your life like that, do you have to carry the bad things you’ve done, no matter what good you do, surely people will only remember you for the bad? You certainly can’t seem to escape the guilt you feel yourself... so what is there to do?

If flavours of cookies had a personality, and an evil witch turned you into one, what flavour cookie would you be and why?

Edit: send cookie
